To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

The Social Choice Correspondence (SCC) of a Constrained Rational Expectation Equilibrium (CREE) can be implemented by a continuous and individually rational mechanism if and only if the CREE is unique and the SCC is single valued.
(i) the mechanism is almost continuous, and (ii) it implements the Social Choice Correspondences induced by constrained rational expectations equilibrium.

(a) the Social Choice Correspondences induced by Constrained and Unconstrained Rational Expectations equilibria coincide, (b) the Social Choice Function induced by Constrained Equilibria is implementable, (c) the Social Choice function induced by Unconstrained Rational Equilibria is not implementable.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: (1) What are the equilibrium properties of a model with heterogeneous agents and heterogeneous expectations, and what are the equilibrium properties that are robust to heterogeneous agents and expectations?
the question of how to implement the constrained rational expectations equilbria of a given model in a decentralized setting.
the following questions: How do we design an economic environment in which the agents will be motivated to behave in a way that will lead to the desired outcome?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the mechanism design theory of Constrained Rational Expectation Equilibria is not well developed, and that the theory of Constrained Bayesian Nash Equilibria is much more developed.

, while the existence of a constrained rational expectations equilibrium is not guaranteed, it can be achieved under a wide range of assumptions and, when it does exist, the associated social choice correspondence is implementable.

the mechanism of the present invention provides a method for continuous and efficient production and delivery of a desired product, in this case, a continuous flow of a product, in a manner such that the product is produced in a controlled environment and delivered in a controlled manner to the consumer.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we provide a new way to study the implementability of constrained rational expectations equilibrium, and we provide a new method to construct an “almost” continuous mechanism for implementing a social choice correspondence.
we show that the Social Choice Correspondences induced by constrained Rational Expectations Equilibrium can be implemented by an almost continuous mechanism.
we show that a large class of social choice correspondences, including the one induced by Constrained REE, is implementable in the presence of non-exclusive information.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the context of Constrained Rational Expectation Equilibria, a mechanism that implements a social choice correspondence can be continuous, even though the social choice correspondence is not.

the set of constrained rational expectations (CRE) equilibria is not only a refinement of the set of Nash equilibria (NE) but also a refinement of the Social Choice Corres-pondence (SCC) induced by NE.
the implementability of Constrained Rational Expectation Equilibria is robust to the addition of a small number of agents, provided that information is non-exclusive.
